SCAN WORLD

Scan

Walks the source camera path at adaptive resolution and measures frame times on this device. The result is stored for the acceptance matrix (W8).

Baked by worldscan: a room reconstructed from video, or a city tile from the map in the Miami Art-Deco style. Room materials are samples chosen from object names. Choose Source camera to replay the original camera path, or Enter world to walk it at real scale.
